**Depends on #62326 and #62405; review only the last commit.**

## Overview

Part 3 of 3 of keeping the loaded parameter objects through `process_weights_after_loading` (PWAL). After #62326 and #62405, a loaded param can still disappear when PWAL deletes or renames it. This PR keeps those params registered, so after PWAL every loader-visible param is still registered under the same name, as the same object, and keeps its loaded data unless that would cost real memory.

## Claims

- **Renames alias one param under both names.** The new `move_parameter(layer, src, dst)` registers the `src` param object under `dst` as well and records `dst` as its runtime name. The loader writes through the checkpoint name and kernels read the runtime name, both pointing at one storage, so a later `replace_parameter` on either name updates both and no extra memory is used. This covers:
  - compressed-tensors `*_weight_packed` (linear, NVFP4/MXFP4/W4A8 MoE);
  - INC MXFP4;
  - the NVFP4 MoE oracle;
  - Humming NVFP4 and Humming's checkpoint-to-standard renames;
  - compressed-tensors W8A16 block FP8, which now aliases `weight_scale_inv` to `weight_scale`.
- **Loaded params no kernel reads keep their data and are marked retired** (`retire_parameter`). This covers:
  - consumed NVFP4 per-tensor scales (ModelOpt, Quark);
  - small Humming leftovers (at most 1/256 of the largest converted tensor);
  - the input scales of ModelOpt and Quark NVFP4 MoE when a weight-only backend (Marlin, Humming) is selected. These used to be set to `None`, which unregistered them. The method now leaves them registered and passes `None` to the MoE quant config.
- **Large released sources stay registered with empty storage** (`replace_parameter(layer, name, t.new_empty(0))`). Their data was converted into a different-layout kernel tensor, so keeping it would double that memory. This covers:
  - unused zero points (Conch, CPU, Marlin, Zentorch, int8 scaled-mm, Quark int8 linear and MoE);
  - KV-cache scale placeholders (`kv_cache.py`, compressed-tensors KV);
  - released weights (XPU W4A8, wNa8o8, dynamic 4-bit, CPU int8, Triton MXFP4 MoE, DeepSeek-V4 XPU MegaMoE L1 weight and SFs, dots3 vision experts, INC ARK);
  - Humming leftovers larger than 1/256 of the largest converted tensor.
- **Readers see the kernel view.**
  - `kernel_parameters(layer)` returns the live params, each object once under its runtime name. `get_live_param` treats retired or empty params as absent. Humming uses both helpers.
  - The Triton MXFP4 MoE wrapper is stored as a plain `<name>_triton` attribute read via `triton_weight()`, so it no longer takes over the param name.
- **Coverage** (whole-tree enumeration of PWAL-reachable sites on `main`, 1786 rows split across the three PRs): 73 delete/rename sites fixed here, plus 36 sites converted together with them (Humming's delete-then-recreate pattern), plus 7 n/a rows inside the changed hunks.

## Validation

- `pre-commit` passes.
- On GB200, `tests/quantization/test_keep_param_objects.py` and `tests/model_executor/test_utils.py` pass: 39 passed.
  - The keep test now also asserts non-empty storage for every loaded param.
  - It runs ModelOpt and compressed-tensors NVFP4 linear and MoE with Marlin and Humming forced.
  - `test_utils.py` covers aliasing, retiring, and the runtime name.
- End-to-end on GB200, `main` vs the stack with this PR. Each run is a cold start with GSM8K (1319 questions, 5-shot), greedy decoding, a byte digest of every post-PWAL tensor, and an object census of loader-visible params:

  | Config | GSM8K main / stack | Post-PWAL tensors | Loader params registered (main → stack) | Kept with empty storage |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | ModelOpt NVFP4 (Qwen3-30B-A3B) | 0.8878 / 0.8886 | identical | 69% → 100% | 0 |
  | ... forced Marlin (3 runs each) | 0.8749, 0.8901, 0.8863 / 0.8779, 0.8893, 0.8855 | identical | 62% → 100% | 0 |
  | ... forced Humming (3 runs each) | 0.8802, 0.8901, 0.8870 / 0.8734, 0.8863, 0.8961 | identical | 69% → 100% | 0 |
  | compressed-tensors NVFP4, forced Humming | 0.8931 / 0.8946 | identical | 36% → 100% | 0 |
  | compressed-tensors MXFP4 MoE (CUTLASS, `*_weight_packed` → `*_weight`) | 0.8582 / 0.8582 (1314/1319 identical text) | identical | 46% → 100% | 0 |

  - Marlin and Humming are not run-to-run deterministic. Two `main` runs agree on about 390 of 1319 GSM8K outputs, so their rows show three runs per arm.
  - The extra tensors in the stack are aliases, with no extra memory, or kept scalars and per-tensor scales. Kept data adds at most 0.15 MiB per model (under 0.001%).
- Direct load of W1 into the live params (`model.load_weights`, no PWAL): every checkpoint name now resolves.
  - On `main`, ModelOpt NVFP4 with Marlin or Humming fails with `has no parameter 'w2_input_scale'`, and compressed-tensors MXFP4 MoE fails with `has no parameter 'w2_weight_packed'`.
  - With this stack, compressed-tensors MXFP4 MoE loads all 675 tensors with no param moved. ModelOpt NVFP4 then stops at a shape mismatch, because Marlin/Humming repack to a different layout.
  - Direct load is only exact for layout-preserving PWAL, as on `main`; layerwise reload is the supported path.
- Layerwise reload W0 → W1:
  - ModelOpt NVFP4: all tensors are byte-identical to a cold start on W1, and greedy matches `main` 8/8.
  - compressed-tensors MXFP4 MoE: all tensors are byte-identical to a cold start on W1, and greedy matches 8/8.
- Earlier runs of the stack (#62326) gave `tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_reload.py`: 74 passed, 1 failed (`test_kv_scale_reload`), the same as on `main`.

## Details

- **Stacked on #62405, not only on #62326:** the same functions (ModelOpt and Quark NVFP4, FBGEMM FP8, INC, Humming NVFP4) both convert and delete params, so this commit applies on top of #62405.
- **Reload:** layerwise reload restores checkpoint-format params before loading. It goes through `layer._parameters`, so both alias names are restored, and a param kept empty is never handed to a `weight_loader`.
- **Humming:** used to delete every param and re-create the set it needs. It now writes through `replace_parameter`. Leftovers are skipped if they alias a replaced param, retired if small, and emptied if large.
- **Weight-only NVFP4 MoE input scales:** Humming's MoE quant config reads the input scales from the layer, so they are retired rather than left live. A live loaded scale would switch Humming to the static checkpoint scale, while `main` uses none.
- **Not kept (exceptions, listed in #62326):** the online FP8 requantization-source `weight_scale`, AutoGPTQ placeholder MoE biases, and torchao tensor subclasses.
